Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red light in Pasadena, Texas, when the rear of the vehicle was strcuk by Driver 2, whose
vehicle was traveling at a speed consistent with the impact described by both drivers. Driver 1 reported pain in the
right shoulder at the scene and stated that the seatbelt tightened hard across the chest on impact. A Passenger
seated in the front right seat reported no injury. Two witnesses standing at the adjacent bus stop told me they saw
Driver 2 fail to slow in time, and photographs taken at the scene show damage to the rear bumper and trunk area that
is largely consistent with the force described. Driver 2 acknowledged the collision without dispute. Some small,
weathered scratches on the rear panel appeared older than the recent damage and were noted but not attributed to
this event. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Driver 1 did not provide identifying
details at the scene, and a claim was filed with the insurer several days later. Injury reported appears plausible given
the mechanism of this collision. No citations were issued at the scene.
